map.核对利润率口径：在「利润率（毛利/售价）」与「加价率（毛利/成本）」之间换算，防: Check the margin basis: convert between 'margin (profit/selling price)' and 'markup (profit/cost)' to avoid mixing bases.
map.举例：成本 100 元、期望利润率 25% → 售价: Example: cost 100 CNY, target margin 25% → selling price
map.售价 = 成本 × (1 + 利润率) = 100 × (1 + 25%) =:
Selling price = cost × (1 + margin) = 100 × (1 + 25%) = 125 CNY.
Profit = 125 - 100 = 25 CNY; margin = 25/125 = 20.0% (note: 'margin 25%' here means 25% cost markup, corresponding to 20% selling-price margin).
Conversely, if price is 125 and cost 100, margin = 20.0%, markup = 25.0%.
map.利润率和加价率不是一回事吗？: Aren't margin and markup the same thing?
map.不是。利润率 = 利润÷售价（电商常用），加价率 = 利润÷成本（实体常用）。成: No. Margin = profit÷price (common in e-commerce), markup = profit÷cost (common in physical retail). At cost 100, price 125, margin is 20%, markup 25%; do not mix them. The tool has a built-in table (e.g. 50% margin = 100% markup) for quick lookup.
map.五变量互算怎么用？: How to use the five-variable cross-calculation?
map.输入任意两项即可求第三项：成本+利润率→售价；售价+利润率→成本；成本+售价→利: Enter any two to get the third: cost+margin→price; price+margin→cost; cost+price→margin/markup. Good for pricing sensitivity tests.
map.加价率 = （售价 − 成本）÷ 成本，与利润率口径不同: Markup = (price - cost) ÷ cost, a different basis from margin
map.输入任意两项即可推出其余，支持成本→售价与售价→成本双向: Enter any two to derive the rest, supporting both cost→price and price→cost directions
